entry.title: Made By AI :: [AI] Juno First for Sega Master System
entry.dc:creator: haroldoop
entry.dc:subject: Made By AI
entry.content:
Author: haroldoop
Subject: [AI] Juno First for Sega Master System
Posted: Sun Nov 15, 2026 1:35 pm (GMT 0)



Juno First SMS
==============

A playable arcade clone of Konami's 1983 perspective space shooter **Juno First** for the **Sega Master System**, written in C using **SDCC** and **devkitSMS**. The project compiles into a 32 KB ROM (`junofirst.sms`) featuring structured enemy formations, bonus astronaut rescues, attract mode, and an automated headless playtest suite.

Github repo: https://github.com/haroldo-ok/juno-first-sms
Itch.io page: https://haroldo-ok.itch.io/juno-first-sms

🚀 Key Features
---------------

- **Perspective Grid & Arcade Action:** Scrolling dotted perspective grid that dynamically responds to forward acceleration and instant reversals, turning red during active bonus mode.

- **Disciplined Enemy Formations:** Waves of three enemies fly in Line, V, Column, and Diagonal formations---including swaying Saucers, tracking Darts, orbiting Spinners, and weaving Bombers---with wingmen peeling off for dive attacks starting in Wave 2.

- **Astronaut Rescue & Multipliers:** Rescuing floating astronauts activates a ~10-second bonus period where consecutive kills scale from 200 up to 2,000 points.

- **Zero-Drop Sprite Handling:** Prevents Master System horizontal sprite dropouts by temporarily rendering overflowing row enemies using their distant mini-sprites, maintaining a locked 60 FPS across dense waves.

- **Audio & Attract Mode:** Includes a ~51-second looping 4-section soundtrack with noise-channel percussion, PSG sound effects, and an automated attract-mode demo after 10 seconds on the title screen.

🕹️ Controls
------------

| **Sega Master System Input** | **Action** |
| --- | --- |
| **D-Pad Left / Right** | Steer ship |
| **D-Pad Up** | Accelerate forward |
| **D-Pad Down** | Reverse direction |
| **Button 1** | Fire weapon |
| **Button 2** | Warp (3 charges per life) |
| **Pause** | Pause game |

🛠️ Building & Testing
----------------------

### Prerequisites

- `sdcc` (4.2 or newer)

- `devkitSMS` (including `ihx2sms` on your `PATH`)

- GNU `make` and Python 3 (for asset/sound generation scripts)

- A Sega Master System emulator or flashcart

### Build & Run Commands

Bash

```
make # Compiles and packages junofirst.sms (32 KB)
make playtest # Rebuilds and runs the automated playtest, attract-mode, and soak suites

```

📂 Repository Layout
--------------------

| **Path** | **Description** |
| --- | --- |
| `src/` | Game loop, formation AI, grid rendering, audio driver, and autopilot logic |
| `tools/` | Python asset and sound generation scripts |
| `tests/` | Scripted input sequences and automated playtest validation files |
| `Makefile` | Build rules and playtest targets |
| `junofirst.sms` | Compiled 32 KB Sega Master System ROM |

📄 Notes & License
------------------

- **Hardware Scope:** Designed to capture the speed and feel of the 1983 arcade original while respecting the Sega Master System's VDP sprite-per-scanline and SN76489 PSG audio constraints.

- **License:** No explicit license file is currently included in the repository; add one prior to public distribution or reuse.

entry.title: Made By AI :: [AI] Dragon Blaster has been turned into a full game
entry.dc:creator: haroldoop
entry.dc:subject: Made By AI
entry.content:
Author: haroldoop
Subject: [AI] Dragon Blaster has been turned into a full game
Posted: Sun Nov 15, 2026 12:38 pm (GMT 0)



Dragon Blaster has been turned into a full game using the demonstration version of Claude Fable 5.2.

Dragon Blaster --- v1.0 Release (Claude Fable 5.2 Build)
======================================================

The **v1.0** release transforms **Dragon Blaster** from a jam prototype into a fully fleshed-out, data-driven shoot-em-up for the **Sega Master System**, packaged in a playable 144 KB ROM (`dragon_blaster.sms`) with complete source files (`dragon-blaster-source.zip`).

Github repo: https://github.com/haroldo-ok/dragon-blaster
Itch.io page: https://haroldo-ok.itch.io/dragon-blaster

Links to the previous non-ai version:
https://www.smspower.org/Homebrew/DragonBlaster-SMS
https://www.smspower.org/forums/18947-CodingCompetition2022DragonBlasterByHarold...

🐲 What's New in v1.0
---------------------

- **5 Distinct Stages:** Emerald Plains (featuring your original terrain), Scorched Dunes, Frozen Peaks, Fallen Fortress, and the Lair of the Lich---complete with unique scenery, music tracks, and enemy waves.

- **5 Multi-Phase Bosses:** Face off against the Imp Chieftain, The Gazer, Frost Wyrm, Inferno Wyrm, and the final Dracolich boss. Each features dedicated life bars, varied attack patterns, and an aggressive enraged second phase.

- **Expanded Bestiary & Ballistics:** 9 distinct enemy types organized across 24 wave formations utilizing 11 varied bullet patterns.

- **Complete Flow & Presentation:** Includes an atmospheric title screen, typed-out story introduction with a built-in how-to-play guide, stage transition cards, stage-clear score tallies, a game-over screen with continue support, and full ending/credits sequences.

- **Robust Audio Suite:** Features 12 original tunes and 13 sound effects compiled via PSGlib.

- **Classic Arcade Rules:** Replaces the old 60-second timer with a proper life/respawn invincibility system, extra lives every 30,000 points, high score tracking, and full pause functionality. Wave-clearing rewards gems, with every third perfect wave granting an elemental orb (losing a life costs your second orb slot).

⌨️ Classic Cheat Codes
----------------------

Enter these sequences using the D-pad on the title screen. A confirmation chime and message will verify entry (entering the code a second time disables it). Cheats persist across continues until the console is reset.

| **D-Pad Sequence** | **Cheat Name** | **Effect** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Up, Up, Down, Down, Left, Right, Left, Right** | **NINE LIVES** | Start and continue with 9 lives. |
| **Left, Left, Right, Right, Up, Down, Up, Down** | **DRAGON SCALES** | Total invulnerability (nothing hurts the dragon). |
| **Down, Down, Up, Up, Right, Left, Right, Left** | **STAGE SELECT** | Use Left/Right on the title screen to pick your starting stage. |
| **Up, Down, Up, Down, Left, Left, Right, Right** | **ELDER BREATH** | Start with Lightning + Fire, retaining both orbs when losing a life. |

*(Note: Compile-time debug switches in `config.h` have been renamed to `DEBUG_INVINCIBLE` and `DEBUG_START_STAGE` to prevent namespace clashes with the new runtime cheat flags).*

🛠️ Performance & Engine Upgrades
---------------------------------

- **Z80 Assembly Hot-Paths:** Actor movement/rendering routines, shot loops, and bullet logic were rewritten in Z80 assembly, skyrocketing frame rates from ~30 fps up to a stable **57--60 fps**.

- **Streamlined Asset Pipeline:** External dependencies like BMP2Tile and Node.js converters have been fully removed in favor of `tool/build_assets.py`.

- **Fully Data-Driven Design (`MODDING.md`):**

- `data/game.ini` handles enemies, waves, bosses, and stages.

- Levels utilize **Tiled** maps, placing waves and items as objects.

- Flight paths are defined via simple waypoint text files.

- Music uses a compact MML text format.

⚠️ Known Items for Tuning & Review
----------------------------------

- **Audio Balance:** Music and sound effects were written "blind" and may benefit from real hardware ear-checks.

- **Difficulty Curve:** Enemy and boss stats (`data/game.ini`) alongside player speeds (`config.h`) are balanced via estimation rather than live player testing.

- **Visual Visibility:** Pale lightning projectiles can occasionally blend into the background against the snowy terrain of the *Frozen Peaks* stage.

- **Left-Edge Shot Culling:** The Fire + Wind combined breath circles leftward as it travels; shots that clip past the absolute left edge of the screen naturally vanish due to standard off-screen clipping rules.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/haroldo-ok/dragon-blaster/compare/v0.11...v1.0

entry.title: Made By AI :: RE: [AI] Jazz Jackrabbit for Game Gear
entry.dc:creator: haroldoop
entry.dc:subject: Made By AI
entry.content:
Author: haroldoop
Subject: Jazz Jackrabbit GG v0.1.0: Add all of the 10 episodes from the original's CD edition.
Posted: Sun Nov 15, 2026 11:25 am (GMT 0)



Jazz Jackrabbit (Sega Game Gear) --- v0.1.0 Release Notes
=======================================================

The **v0.1.0** update brings a technical achievement to handheld retro development: a complete, standalone **4 MB Sega Game Gear ROM (`jazz-jackrabbit.gg`)** packing all **10 episodes (66 stages)** of the original *Jazz Jackrabbit* CD edition, complete with the full front-end, 3D bonus levels, SRAM saves, and a fully overhauled Z80 sound engine.

🚀 Key Features & Port Highlights
---------------------------------

- **All 10 Episodes Included:** Features episodes 1--6, A, B, C, and the Christmas special (*Holiday Hare*). Each stage includes its native tile sets, sprite sheets, palette cycling, enemy logic, guardians, and dedicated music.

- **Complete Front-End & Menus:** Retains the original title screen, main menu, episode selection list with preview artwork, planet screens, level/bonus clear screens, endings, game-over screens, and setup menus.

- **3D Bonus Levels:** Fully playable bonus stages accessible either via the standard red diamond in-game or directly from the final row of the episode selection menu.

- **Battery-Backed Saves:** Supports **4 save slots** saved in cartridge SRAM (access via pause, then press `1`), preserving game progress and configuration options.

- **Classic Cheat Code Support:** The legendary stage select cheat is fully functional on the title or main menu: **`Up, Up, Down, Down, Left, Right, Left, Right, 2, 1`**.

🎵 Overhauled Z80 Sound & Music Engine
--------------------------------------

Adapting complex MS-DOS `.PSM` tracker music to the Game Gear's SN76489 PSG sound chip required a complete rewrite of the music converter and Z80 playback driver:

- **Multi-Bank Music Streaming:** Because several CD-edition songs require more than a single 16 KB ROM bank, the music player was extended to dynamically page across multiple banks (~320 KB total music footprint in the 4 MB ROM).

- **Accurate Pitch Correction:** Fixed pitch mapping for nearly half of the instrument samples (correcting keys that were previously off by fourths or fifths) and eliminated wholesale song transpositions.

- **Pitch Bends & Vibrato:** Native support for exact pitch movement, including slides, vibrato, pitch bends, and falling tom effects.

- **Balanced Perceived Loudness:** Adjusted mixing balances so that noise-channel simulated drums sit properly in the mix rather than overpowering melody channels.

- **Chords & Bass Management:** Chords now utilize free channels rather than buzzing arpeggios, and deep bass lines are safely constrained within the Game Gear's frequency limits.

⚙️ Technical Specifications & Known Limits
------------------------------------------

- **Testing & Verification:** Game logic perfectly matches the Genesis core across all 264 test runs on the host and 66 runs on the Z80 ROM. All 66 stages boot, load via menus, and render without tile-cache overflows.

- **Performance:** Busy action scenes run at approximately **30 FPS**, while core game simulation maintains its full speed.

- **Bonus Stage Constraints:** The 3D bonus stage floor uses a coarser resolution (**40×10 samples**), and starting a bonus stage introduces a brief multi-second black screen during loading.

- **Hardware Status:** Extensively verified within headless emulators; physical Game Gear hardware testing remains pending.

entry.title: Made By AI :: RE: [AI] [WIP] A new kind of porting - Chrono Runner (from MSX)
entry.dc:creator: tachyMC
entry.dc:subject: Made By AI
entry.content:
Author: tachyMC
Posted: Sun Nov 15, 2026 11:04 am (GMT 0)

haroldoop wrote
Pretty awesome!

Thanks! Most of the work is from Opus LLM, but I made my best to direct it and point out issues when there were any.

segarule wrote
Why not port it with mode 4 in mind. Would be better use SMS colors?

Thanks for the feedback!

For the Chrono Runner game, a port optimized for Mode 4 would probably be better for avoiding the color clash limitations. The original game for MSX has many, and it shows already in the game splashscreen (it's attached to this message).

Pay attention to the two clocks in the Chrono Runner logo! Some regions are red while they should be white. That's the color clash caused by the Graphics Mode 2 limitations.

Apart from the color clash... I don't know if there could be any other significant improvement. The original game does not feature scrolling, and the whole tilemap is already very optimized (so, no improvements from flipping).

So... I'm not sure! I think that I will finish the first version focusing on the compatibility layer, then will share both ROM and source so you all can suggest where to go from there!
